before.title: Ghost Cat Sticker, Cute Halloween Cat Sticker, Spooky Kitty Laptop Decal, Waterproof Vinyl Sticker
before.description:
A little cat who dressed up as a ghost for Halloween and never took the sheet off. This big-eyed ghost cat is hand-drawn in soft grays and black with a blush of pink, and is ready to haunt your laptop, water bottle, notebook, or planner all year long.

Choose your finish:
• Glossy: glossy laminated, waterproof vinyl
• Holographic: sparkly, light-catching finish (sparkle looks different in every light)

Drawn, designed, printed, and cut by me, who I am told is a human. No AI was used in the creation of these stickers.

Some photos are digital mockups showing the actual size. Colors and sparkle vary by screen and light.
